tasks.name: 创建博客数据模型
tasks.description: 设计并创建博客的数据模型，包括标题、内容和图片字段，保存到数据库。

tasks.name: 创建图片存储机制
tasks.description: 设计并实现图片的存储机制，支持上传的图片文件保存到服务器或云存储。

tasks.name: 创建博客API接口
tasks.description: 创建博客的后端API接口，提供增删改查功能，包括支持图片上传和预览。

tasks.name: 实现图片上传API
tasks.description: 创建图片上传的后端API接口，支持接收图片文件并返回预览URL。

tasks.name: 创建首页/博客列表页
tasks.description: 创建显示博客列表的HTML页面，展示所有博客的标题和缩略图，支持响应式设计。

tasks.name: 创建博客详情页
tasks.description: 创建显示单篇博客详情的HTML页面，展示标题、内容和图片，支持响应式设计。

tasks.name: 创建新建博客页面
tasks.description: 创建新建博客的HTML表单页面，包含标题、内容输入框和图片上传功能，支持实时预览上传的图片。

tasks.name: 实现响应式设计
tasks.description: 为所有前端页面添加响应式设计，确保在不同设备上有良好的用户体验。

T1.implementation_approach: Design a database schema with tables for blogs, authors, and categories, including fields like title, content, timestamps, and relationships.
T1.notes: Ensure scalability and consider indexing for faster queries.

T2.implementation_approach: Use a cloud storage service (e.g., AWS S3) or local storage with unique file naming and directory structure for organizing images.
T2.notes: Implement security measures to prevent unauthorized access.

T3.implementation_approach: Develop RESTful API endpoints for CRUD operations on blogs using a framework like Django REST Framework or Express.js.
T3.notes: Include authentication and validation for secure access.

T4.implementation_approach: Create an API endpoint to handle image uploads, validate file types, and store them in the designated storage mechanism.
T4.notes: Set file size limits and handle errors gracefully.

T5.implementation_approach: Build a homepage and blog list page using a frontend framework like React or Vue, fetching data from the blog API.

T6.implementation_approach: Create a detailed blog page that fetches and displays a single blog's content using its unique ID.
T6.notes: Include related blogs or comments for better user engagement.

T7.implementation_approach: Develop a form-based page for creating new blogs, with fields for title, content, and image upload, and connect it to the blog API.
T7.notes: Validate inputs and provide user feedback on submission.

T8.implementation_approach: Use CSS frameworks like Bootstrap or Tailwind to ensure the design adapts to different screen sizes and devices.
T8.notes: Test responsiveness on various devices and browsers.
